description: The T: / C: / S: marker convention some analysts type. The markers are the analyst's own words, so nothing strips them: the coordinate is read out of the C: line, the S: link is the sole candidate and becomes the source, and the title is the first line verbatim, its T: marker included. No fixture serves the linked status, so the chase degrades to link-only: no source date and no source media, and the OP photo stays proof. The bot tag on its own line is addressing rather than content, so it leaves the proof.
title: T: Strike on the depot
